question: How do I choose the right NOC code for the jobs in my Express Entry profile?
answer:
To choose the right NOC code for the jobs in your Express Entry profile, follow these steps:

1. Enter your job title in the “Filter items” field (Source: [2] ARCHIVED – Find your NOC – version 2016, https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/immigrate-canada/express-entry/eligibility/find-national-occupation-code-2016.html).
2. As you type words, the table will change to display related words.
3. Write down the numeric code shown on the left column (Source: [2] ARCHIVED – Find your NOC – version 2016, https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/immigrate-canada/express-entry/eligibility/find-national-occupation-code-2016.html).
4. For example: 7253
5. Write down the NOC title shown on the centre column (Source: [2] ARCHIVED – Find your NOC – version 2016, https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/immigrate-canada/express-entry/eligibility/find-national-occupation-code-2016.html).
6. For example: Gas fitters
7. If you couldn’t find your NOC in the above table, go to the search page of the NOC website and search your job title or the NOC code (Source: [4] ARCHIVED – Find your NOC – version 2016, https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/immigrate-canada/express-entry/eligibility/find-national-occupation-code-2016.html).

Make sure the main duties listed match what you did at your job. If they don't, you will need to find a different job title with duties that match yours.

question: What happens if I work more than 24 hours a week off campus during the school term?
answer: If you work more than 24 hours per week off campus during the school term, you can lose your student status and may not be approved for a study or work permit in the future. You may also have to leave the country. (Source: [1] Work off campus as an international student, https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/work/work-off-campus.html)
